description: Use only when finding strong, non-hiring LinkedIn posts, enriching a relevant prospect, and drafting or submitting one concise, grounded comment. Use authorized Google Sheet tracking for any external comment; without it, limit work to read-only discovery and drafting. Apply bounded `copywriting` and `humanizer` passes for comment prose. Do not use for hiring posts, initial connection requests, or publishing the user's own posts.
